description: Na₂BrCl is Caswellsilverite structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to three equivalent Br¹⁻ and three equivalent Cl¹⁻ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaBr₃Cl₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Br bond lengths are 2.93 Å. All Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.83 Å. Br¹⁻ is bonded to six equivalent Na¹⁺ atoms to form BrNa₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ClNa₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent BrNa₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent ClNa₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 3°. Cl¹⁻ is bonded to six equivalent Na¹⁺ atoms to form ClNa₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent BrNa₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent BrNa₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent ClNa₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 3°.
